raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows store numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of names, and silver_customers only applies upper(), so the codes pass through unmapped. raw_region_map provides an exact 1:1 mapping from these codes to region names, so silver_customers should map through it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
